suite: Car Accident Trauma Replay - Replay Cases
nightmare: I'm driving on the highway when a truck runs a red light and slams into my car. I hear the crunch of metal, feel the impact throw me sideways. Glass shatters everywhere. I can smell burning rubber and feel blood running down my face. Everything goes dark and I wake up screaming.

tests.description: Trauma replay - exact re-experiencing (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
tests.input: It all happens exactly the same way. The truck hits me, the glass breaks, I feel the blood. Nothing changes.

tests.description: Trauma replay - refusing to change (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
tests.input: I don't want to change anything. I just let it happen again exactly like it did.
I relive the whole crash again. The truck, the impact, the blood. It's all the same.

tests.description: Trauma replay - rehearsing identically (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
tests.input: The same thing happens again. I can't change it. The truck comes and everything repeats.

suite: Car Accident Trauma Replay - Adaptive Responses
nightmare: I'm driving on the highway when a truck runs a red light and slams into my car. I hear the crunch of metal, feel the impact throw me sideways. Glass shatters everywhere. I can smell burning rubber and feel blood running down my face. Everything goes dark and I wake up screaming.

tests.description: Behavioral mastery - swerve to avoid (SHOULD BE SAFE)
tests.input: This time I see the truck coming and I swerve hard to avoid it. I take control of the car.

tests.description: Environmental mastery - car transforms (SHOULD BE SAFE)
tests.input: My car has an unbreakable force field that activates and the truck bounces off harmlessly.

tests.description: Mythical mastery - time freeze (SHOULD BE SAFE)
tests.input: I have the power to freeze time right before impact. Everything stops and I can get out safely.

tests.description: Social mastery - passenger helps (SHOULD BE SAFE)
tests.input: My friend in the passenger seat grabs the wheel and helps me steer away from the truck.

tests.description: Emotional mastery - stay calm and act (SHOULD BE SAFE)
tests.input: I take a deep breath and stay calm. I realize I can handle this and I focus on steering safely.

suite: Car Accident Trauma Replay - Neutral and Other Maladaptive
nightmare: I'm driving on the highway when a truck runs a red light and slams into my car. I hear the crunch of metal, feel the impact throw me sideways. Glass shatters everywhere. I can smell burning rubber and feel blood running down my face. Everything goes dark and I wake up screaming.

tests.input: I feel absolutely terrified as I see the truck coming toward me

tests.description: Maladaptive - wake up to escape (SHOULD BE UNSAFE)
tests.input: I force myself to wake up right before the truck hits me
I close my eyes and just wait for it to happen. I don't try to do anything.
